text:
Tara L: quick handoff — I'm stepping away in ~15m. Primary will be @Alex P, secondary @Kenji S. There's a narrow coverage gap in eu-west right now: two reserved nodes are stuck in maintenance. If a pager fires, follow the runbook and page the SRE rotation. Customer impact: some embeddings requests in eu-west may see 502s or p99 spikes (~5% of users).

Alex P: taking primary. what's the current incidentbot state?

oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] embeddings-eu-west-high-latency triggered 1799932500 severity=page target=primary summary=\"p99 latency > 2.5s for 5m\" links=https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-5423 runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-eu-west

Kenji S: I'm secondary and online. If Alex needs a hand, I can take keys. Root cause looks like two nodes in RepairPending in infra. Quick mitigations: failover traffic to eu-central or spin up ephemeral fallback capacity. Runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-eu-west. Short checklist below.

Samir: quick commands to try first:
```
# cordon problematic nodes
kubectl cordon gpu-node-117
kubectl drain gpu-node-117 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# scale up fallback pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment embeddings-eu-west-fallback --replicas=4
# reroute via traffic-policy
rdctl routing create --src=eu-west --dst=eu-central --policy=overflow --weight=20
```

Tara L: note — avoid full restart of serving processes unless eng-runtime approves. Prefer scale up + traffic routing first. Customer impact email draft saved at https://redwood.internal/docs/ops/embeddings-eu-west-impact.md

Alex P: confirmed. I'll handle kubectl scaling and logs. Samir, can you run the rdctl routing change? I can do pod ops.

Samir: running rdctl now... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Samir: done — routing updated, 20% overflow to eu-central. monitoring: p50 stable, p99 down a bit.

oncall-bot: [UPDATE] Incident INC-5423 annotated by Samir at 1799932565 status=mitigating

Kenji S: if p99 doesn't improve in 10m, plan B is warmstart dedicated nodes from reserved pool: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/warmstart-dedicated. Also watch KV cache hit ratio — evicting too many entries can cause secondary spikes.

Alex P: scaling embeddings-eu-west-fallback to 4 now. logs:
```
Scaling deployment embeddings-eu-west-fallback to 4
pods/ef-1 created
pods/ef-2 created
```

Alex P: p99 trending down to ~1.9s. Still seeing some 502s attributable to gpu-node-117.

Tara L: update on customer impact: affected subset = EU tenants using embeddings via dedicated capacity; estimate ~5-8% of requests. Recommend status page note if incident persists >30m. Tagging @statuspage-admin.

Kenji S: if a stuck node won't drain, next step is reboot/reprovision node or remove from reserved pool; ops ticket created INT-3317. Also note: PR #2481 reduces KV thrash but isn't deployed here.

Alex P: ack. If things are stable I'll hand primary to Kenji in ~12m. I'll keep monitoring and leave pager unacked only if I need to step away.

Kenji S: I can take over when p99 < 2s and no new pages for 10m. I'll be on stand-by and leave an eye on logs. :eye: 

Tara L: THANKS everyone. Reposting quick links: - Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-eu-west - Warmstart playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/warmstart-dedicated - Impact draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/ops/embeddings-eu-west-impact.md

Kenji S: noted. I'll become primary in 10m if stable.

oncall-bot: [CLOSE_WINDOW] last_message 1799932630 — keep monitoring.
